features.description: Recover OTLP destinations after startup outages
acceptance_criteria: Regression test fails on the original startup gate, then passes after its removal.
Both OTLP-only and dual-export initialization retain the configured HTTP exporter without a reachability preflight.
A collector started after initialization receives a later span; initialization does not contact the collector.
HTTPS URL without explicit port follows HTTP transport semantics in a deterministic test.
Export and shutdown remain bounded; invalid transport configuration cannot be reported as successful delivery.
features.notes: Targeted telemetry/observatory tests and race checks pass; independent focused rereview found no blocking issue. Red/green logs recorded in the plan.

acceptance_criteria: An explicit initialization report distinguishes disabled, registered and degraded destinations; registration is labeled delivery-unverified.
Both daemon startup consumers use that report rather than environment-based success inference.
Tests cover GCP timeout/failure and successful registration alongside OTLP without real cloud credentials.
Failed initialization and late GCP constructor completion clean up owned resources; successful shutdown does not double-close exporters.
features.notes: Targeted telemetry/observatory tests and race checks pass; independent focused rereview found no blocking issue. Red/green logs recorded in the plan.

features.description: Verify linked delivery and document rollout
acceptance_criteria: Real OTLP HTTP protobuf emission reaches the production receiver/conversion path and stores trace/task/chain/stage identities in a temporary database.
Recovery and failure tests use isolated loopback fixtures, no production writes and no external model calls.
Relevant tests, race checks, lint/build and architecture boundaries pass; any full-suite environmental/baseline failure is recorded rather than hidden.
Documentation distinguishes registration from receipt, explains outage/data-loss limits, and gives a concrete staged production verification procedure.
Independent sprint evaluation records acceptance evidence and any remaining rollout gate.
features.notes: Real receiver persistence/race tests pass; build/lint/boundaries and repository suite excluding four environment-sensitive tests pass. Independent report records strict full-suite promotion failure. No production rollout.
